description.value: The Market at Big White is a full-service mid-mountain grocery, deli bistro, and liquor store located in the heart of Big White ski village. The grocery section carries fresh produce, meat and seafood, dairy, and baked goods, while the deli bistro offers made-daily sandwiches, soups, pizza slices, and hot savoury pastries. The on-site liquor store boasts Okanagan wines and ciders alongside a broad spirits and beer selection.

address.value: 5315 Big White Rd, Big White, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is complete and current (copyright 2026), confirming an active full-service grocery, deli bistro, and liquor store at Big White ski village. Basic groceries and hot food are explicitly described on the grocery and deli subpages. No mention anywhere of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, ice, or any cycling-specific amenity on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address; website supplies both ((250) 765-7666 and 5315 Big White Rd, Big White, BC) — these have been used in the listing.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 08:30-21:00) partially conflicts with website's stated summer hours (Mon–Wed 9am–4pm, Thu–Sun 9am–5pm); OSM tags may reflect winter/ski-season hours only.
Big White is a ski resort community at elevation; road cycling access is highly seasonal and the immediate area caters primarily to ski and mountain-bike visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible grocery and deli business at Big White ski village with an active website and clear product offerings; useful to cyclists accessing Big White during summer mountain-bike season.

Hot food.detail: Deli Bistro page lists daily-made sandwiches & wraps, soups (with bread roll), pizza slices, meat pies, sausage rolls, and spinach and feta pastry, described as 'a warm lunch or a quick snack.'

wow_evidence: full-service mid-mountain grocery, deli bistro, and liquor store
